title: Levenda's Unholy Alliance on Nazis and the Nordic tall whites

tellings.quote: you know, he writes about this unholy alliance where he talks about the Nazis, you know, uh, sort of, uh, aligning themselves with the tall whites of the Nordics and there being some sort of secret technology.

plain: The writer Peter Levenda, in his book Unholy Alliance, writes that the Nazis aligned themselves with the "tall whites" of the Nordics, the tall, pale, human-looking beings of UFO lore, and that some kind of secret technology was involved. Michels brings this up himself, also crediting Levenda's essay "Black Sunrise" in the collection Lovers of Sophia. If true, the Nazi regime would have had dealings with beings that were not human.
